about.title: About
about.privacy: MoonBot sends no telemetry. With Ollama, your messages never leave this PC. With a cloud provider, they go to that provider. API keys are kept in Windows Credential Manager, never in plain files.
error.connection: the server at {0} is not answering. Is it running?
error.insecureKey: API keys are only sent over HTTPS (or to this PC).
error.timeout: the server took too long to answer.
ai.systemPrompt: You are MoonBot, a friendly desktop assistant shaped like a small moon, made by Moon Technologies. Always reply in {0}. Be clear and concise; use short paragraphs or lists when they help. If you are not sure about something, say so.
action.find.title: Find a file
action.find.body: Type /find and a name — instant, no AI
action.organize.title: Organize files
action.organize.body: Folders, renames and moves — with your OK
action.ask.title: Ask anything
action.drop.title: Drop files here
action.drop.body: Then tell me what to do with them
prompt.downloads: What is in my Downloads folder? Give me a short summary.
prompt.organize: Look at my Downloads folder and propose a few folders to organize it. Then create them and move the files.
tool.denied: You said no — nothing was changed.
tools.unavailable: This model can't use tools, so I can only chat. For file tasks, pick a model with tools (for example nemotron-3-nano:4b) in Settings → AI.

appearance.title: Appearance

files.title: Files & permissions
files.enable: Let MoonBot work with my files
files.enableHelp: MoonBot can search and look inside folders on its own. Creating folders, renaming and moving always ask you first. It can never delete anything.
files.cloudNote: With a cloud provider, the names of the files involved are sent to that provider.
files.audit: Every action is written to the log on this PC.
settings.modelToolsHint: Tip: for file tasks, use a model that supports tools (e.g. nemotron-3-nano:4b). gemma3 is great for chatting but can't use tools.
